summary: Iteration 46: All 8 bug fixes and features verified PASSED. Chat expand from minimized avatar works correctly. Card minimize button adds to sessionStorage and navigates back. Card pills appear LEFT of AI pill in minimized state. No overlap between pills verified. Click card pill opens card. Expanded state shows AI (violet) left, Chat (orange) right. Chat page attachment drawer has 6 options. Backend AI chat returns response.
critical_code_review_comments: FloatingChatBubble.jsx: Bug fix verified - clicking minimized avatar calls setMinimized(false) and expands chat window
ViewCardPage.jsx: Minimize button adds card to NavScrollContext.minimizedCards and navigates back
NavScrollContext.jsx: sessionStorage persistence for bruno_min_cards working correctly
FloatingBubbles.jsx: Card pills tray positioned LEFT of AI pill with proper CSS positioning
MobileBottomNav.jsx: Touch handlers for swipe gestures working (swipe up=expand, down=minimize)
No overlap verified: Card pills (8-36px) < AI pill (95-135px) < BRUNO pill (142-248px) < Chat pill (255-295px)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 46 verified all bug fixes and new features. Key findings: 1) Chat expand from minimized avatar BUG FIX works - clicking minimized avatar expands nav bar and shows chat window with input field. 2) Card minimize button on ViewCardPage adds card to sessionStorage('bruno_min_cards') and navigates back. 3) Card pills appear in minimized-cards-tray to the LEFT of AI pill. 4) No overlap between elements verified with pixel positions. 5) Clicking card pill navigates to /c/{cardId}. 6) Expanded state shows AI bubble (violet) at bottom-left and Chat bubble (orange) at bottom-right, both above nav bar. 7) Chat page attachment drawer has 6 options: Camara, Galeria, Video, Documento, Tarjeta, Sticker. 8) Backend AI chat returns response and session_id.

test_1_bug_fix_chat_expand_from_avatar.details: After minimizing with open chat, clicking minimized avatar expands nav bar and shows chat window with input field

test_2_card_minimize_button.details: Card minimize button exists on /c/{cardId}, clicking it navigates back and adds card to sessionStorage

test_3_card_pill_in_minimized_state.details: After minimizing card, navigating to /feed and scrolling down shows minimized-cards-tray with card pill

test_4_no_overlap.details: Card pill RIGHT (36) < AI pill LEFT (95), AI pill RIGHT (135) < BRUNO pill LEFT (142), BRUNO pill RIGHT (248) < Chat pill LEFT (255)

test_6_expanded_state.details: AI bubble (violet) at bottom-left (x=12), Chat bubble (orange) at bottom-right (x=338), nav bar visible

test_7_chat_page_attachment_drawer.details: Attachment drawer shows 6 options: Camara, Galeria, Video, Documento, Tarjeta, Sticker

test_8_backend_ai_chat.details: POST /api/ai/chat with {message:'Hola'} returns response and session_id
